<RuleLanguageLinks current="javascript" languages={[{"id":"javascript","label":"JavaScript (and super languages)","href":"/linter/rules/no-object-constructor/javascript/"}]} />

:::caution
This rule is part of the [nursery](/linter/#nursery) group. This means that it is experimental and the behavior can change at any time.
:::
## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.6.0`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/noObjectConstructor`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule has an [**unsafe**](/linter/#unsafe-fixes) fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**information**](/reference/diagnostics#information).
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`no-object-constructor`](https://eslint.org/docs/latest/rules/no-object-constructor)
  - Inspired from [`no-new-object`](https://eslint.org/docs/latest/rules/no-new-object)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noObjectConstructor": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Disallow calling `Object` without arguments to create an empty object.

`Object()` and `new Object()` without arguments both create an empty object, the same as `{}`.
Writing `{}` is shorter and clearer, and it always creates a plain object,
even if other code replaces the global `Object`.

Calls with an argument, such as `Object(value)`, are allowed because they convert `value` to an object.

## Examples

### Invalid

```js
const obj = Object();
```

### Valid

```js
const obj = {};
const wrapped = Object(value);
const alsoWrapped = new Object(value);
// Here, `Object` is a parameter, not the built-in `Object`.
const createObject = (Object) => new Object();
```

## See Also

- To use `[]` instead of the `Array` constructor, see [`useArrayLiterals`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/use-array-literals/).
- To require `new` when calling built-in constructors such as `Object`, see [`useConsistentBuiltinInstantiation`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/use-consistent-builtin-instantiation/).
This rule reports both `Object()` and `new Object()` when they have no arguments.
